title: Fire Update
description: This mod adds many different items related to the fire upgrade to minecraft: tools, blocks, materials, etc.
body:
This mod Adds some new items to Minecraft. 
  Tools: Pickaxe made of tempered iron, Sword made of tempered iron,
               Fire Sword (sets the enemy on fire)
  Blocks: Burnt turf, Burnt log, Smoldering bush, Burnt foliage, Hardened Iron                         
         ore, and others.
You can also craft some items on the workbench.
